payload.name: Habit formation curve
payload.fact: With repetition of a behavior in a consistent context, automaticity increases following an asymptotic curve.
payload.boundary: The time to reach 95% of the asymptote of automaticity varies significantly between individuals.

provenance.title: How are habits formed: Modelling habit formation in the real world
provenance.quote_or_locus: With repetition of a behaviour in a consistent context, automaticity increases following an asymptotic curve which can be modelled at the individual level

provenance.title: How are habits formed: Modelling habit formation in the real world
provenance.quote_or_locus: The time it took participants to reach 95% of their asymptote of automaticity ranged from 18 to 254 days; indicating considerable variation in how long it takes people to reach their limit of automaticity
